import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Val {
        double fi, se;
        Val(double fi, double se) {
            this.fi = fi;
            this.se = se;
        }
    }

    static Val Add(Val f, Val s) {
        return new Val(f.fi + s.fi, f.se + s.se);
    }

    static Val Sub(Val f, Val s) {
        return new Val(f.fi - s.fi, f.se - s.se);
    }

    static Val Mult(Val f, double w) {
        return new Val(f.fi * w, f.se * w);
    }

    static Val Div(Val f, double w) {
        return new Val(f.fi / w, f.se / w);
    }

    static Val[] dp;
    static int n, k;
    static double[] p;
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;

    static double Solve(int vr) {
        if (p[vr] < EPS) return 0.0;

        int size = 1 << n;
        dp = new Val[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            dp[i] = new Val(0.0, 0.0);
        }
        dp[0] = new Val(1.0, 0.0);

        for (int msk = 1; msk < size; msk++) {
            if ((msk & (1 << vr)) != 0) continue;
            Val ri = new Val(0.0, 0.0);
            double same = 0.0;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (i != vr && ((msk & (1 << i)) ) != 0) {
                    same += p[i];
                    ri = Add(ri, Mult(dp[msk ^ (1 << i)], p[i]));
                }
            }
            dp[msk] = Div(ri, 1.0 - same);
        }

        Val tot = new Val(1.0, 0.0);
        for (int msk = 1; msk < size; msk++) {
            if ((msk & (1 << vr)) == 0) {
                tot = Add(tot, dp[msk]);
            }
        }

        double alp = (1.0 - tot.se) / tot.fi;

        Val bad = new Val(0.0, 0.0);
        for (int msk = 0; msk < size; msk++) {
            if ((msk & (1 << vr)) != 0) continue;
            int bitsCount = Integer.bitCount(msk);
            if (bitsCount >= k) {
                bad = Add(bad, dp[msk]);
            }
        }

        return 1.0 - (alp * bad.fi + bad.se);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = sc.nextDouble();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.out.printf("%.12f%c", Solve(i), (i + 1 == n ? '\n' : ' '));
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
